claim: A multi-agent system can autonomously distinguish speckle-dominated degradation in coherent far-field imaging from noise-dominated degradation in fluorescence imaging and invoke modality-specific processing tools, and can translate a published study into a local workflow comprising paper interpretation, experimental planning, pilot optical acquisition, reconstruction-model implementation, training, and evaluation.
falsifier: One can implement a multi-agent system with diagnostic and tool-selection capabilities and test its ability to autonomously reproduce published experimental protocols across different scientific domains.

conditions: coherent far-field imaging and fluorescence imaging modalities
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported AHOIS system and the specific imaging modalities and published study used; transfer to other domains or more complex workflows is unestablished.
